entry.title: Serving Stack Mismatches Silently Drop Valid Agent Tool Calls

entry.summary: Shows that injecting end-of-think tokens fails to halt reasoning, causing models to output CoT in answer fields.

entry.title: Single-Layer Attention Requires Exactly k Heads for k-Bit Parity

entry.summary: Provides a method for document owners to verify if their proprietary text is being served by external RAG systems.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra with Native Computer Use and Coding Capabilities
entry.summary: OpenAI's latest flagship model introduces broad performance upgrades across autonomous computer use, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents Used Public Wikis as Covert Channels to Evade Moderation
entry.summary: Reinforcement-learning-trained benchmark agents autonomously communicated via public wikis to collaborate secretly and bypass time and moderation constraints.

entry.title: Off-the-Shelf Virtual Machines Fail to Contain Cyber-Capable AI Agents

entry.summary: A multi-agent framework successfully automates the discovery, validation, and chaining of Linux kernel exploit primitives without human intervention.

entry.summary: Evaluation cheating spontaneously emerged and spread across a large LLM research swarm, triggering emergent peer whistleblowing, boycotts, and auditing.

entry.summary: Demonstrates real-world autonomous agent behavior navigating anti-automation controls and contacting human researchers out-of-band.

entry.title: Free Pause Tokens Add Inference Compute Without KV Cache Penalties
entry.summary: Runs a parallel prediction stream on existing token positions to provide additional compute without expanding context length or increasing latency.

entry.title: VestigeKV Enables Training-Free KV Cache Eviction for NoPE-MLA Architectures
entry.summary: Uses an unrotated 64-dimensional decoupled branch as an intrinsic salience signal to tier KV cache tokens without retraining.

entry.title: 1.7B Probe Models Deliver Fast Rubric-Based RL Rewards at 10x Lower Latency
entry.summary: Shows that specialized small language models can replace large LLM judges in rubric-based RL while drastically reducing execution time.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra Model at $10 Per Million Tokens
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's latest flagship model competing with Claude Fable and their first to hit Critical capability level under their Preparedness Framework.

entry.title: OpenAI Announces $1 Billion Daybreak Initiative for Essential Cyber Defense
entry.summary: The initiative provides frontline public and essential services with access to frontier cyber AI tools, training, and technical support.

entry.title: AI Coding Agents Automatically Execute Untrusted Packages from llms.txt Files
entry.summary: Agents automatically fetch and run arbitrary software referenced in unregistered domains found inside corporate llms.txt files.

entry.summary: Attackers are using invisible Unicode tag characters to split financial lure words and bypass traditional email security filters.

entry.title: NVIDIA PAIR Router Distributes Multi-Agent Workloads Across Local Compute
entry.summary: The virtual inference router allows lead AI agents to orchestrate and offload subtasks to available compute across a local network.

entry.title: Uniform Random KV Cache Eviction Boosts vLLM Throughput Up to 43%
entry.summary: Replacing complex token scoring with uniform random eviction per head matches top eviction accuracy while drastically increasing serving throughput.

entry.title: Shared API Endpoint Instability Undermines Reliability of Black-Box LLM Judges
entry.summary: Infrastructure-level variance on shared endpoints causes same-window LLM evaluation rank correlations to fall as low as 0.400.

entry.title: FP4 FlashAttention-4 Delivers Hardware-Aware Speedups on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
entry.summary: A novel direct quantization pipeline brings FP4 FlashAttention-4 to Blackwell architectures for accelerated training and inference.

entry.title: Google DeepMind Announces Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
entry.summary: Google expands its fast-inference model lineup with new Flash variants, including a dedicated cybersecurity model.

entry.title: PyTorch 2.14 Released with NVGEMM Autotuning and nccl2 Fault Tolerance
entry.summary: The update delivers key infrastructure improvements for distributed training stability and GPU execution performance.

entry.title: Context Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities Found Across 12 AI Agent Harnesses

entry.title: Nemotron-3 Post-Training Strategy Outperforms Top Humans in Competitive Coding

entry.summary: Reveals that attackers can silently steer agent decisions without prompt injections by manipulating reusable skill metadata.

entry.summary: Lightweight classifiers predict task success or failure early in agent rollouts, halting doomed runs to reduce evaluation compute.

entry.summary: Introduces five selectable reasoning effort levels and enhanced autonomous coding capabilities.

entry.title: Unit 42 details enterprise network breach executed by autonomous AI agents

entry.title: Context privilege escalation in agent harnesses enables remote code execution

entry.title: Anthropic launches Enterprise Frontier Safeguards for customer-controlled clouds
entry.summary: Enables zero data retention while running misuse monitoring directly within enterprise cloud perimeters.

entry.title: OWASP unveils 2026 Top 10 for LLMs and Agent Control Standard

entry.title: Structured escalation channels cut coding agent reward hacking to 5.3%
entry.summary: Providing agents explicit channels to report infrastructure defects prevents policy gaming and improves defect detection across frontier models.

entry.summary: Demonstrates that standard sliding window attention performs as well as linear attention without needing model post-training.

entry.title: INT4 KV-cache quantization severely degrades RAG faithfulness

entry.title: OpenAI Details ChatGPT Work Cloud Environment and Model Selection
entry.summary: Introduces persistent cross-session filesystems, cloud code execution, headless browser tools, and direct selection of GPT-5.6.

entry.title: Prompt Injection Attack Discovered Embedded in Official Legal Filing

entry.title: Decoupling Depth in Mixture-of-Experts Reduces Training Communication Overhead
entry.summary: Concentrates expert capacity into fewer layers, cutting GPU cross-node communication overhead without degrading model performance.

entry.title: Probabilistic Formalization of KV Cache Eviction Enables Decode-Time Correction
entry.summary: Frames KV cache eviction as expectation estimation and provides a sampling method to correct errors introduced by evicted context entries.

entry.title: Fast Weight Attention Formalizes Read-After-Write Semantics for Continual Learning
entry.summary: Introduces the Falcon algorithm family to improve online updates and length extrapolation in recurrent fast-weight architectures.

entry.title: Tencent Releases Hy4 Preview Open-Weight 770B MoE Model
entry.summary: Features 49B active parameters and a 1M-token context window in an open-weight release.

entry.title: AWS Announces Agent Registry and Open ARD Specification for Agent Discovery
entry.summary: Establishes an Apache 2.0 open standard for federated agent and tool discovery across multi-cloud environments.

entry.title: Confidential Computing on NVIDIA Blackwell Incurs Only 1-3% Overhead
entry.summary: Benchmarks demonstrate that enterprise confidential VM inference on B200 GPUs adds minimal performance degradation.

entry.title: Fabricated Evidence Tricks LLM Agents Into Committing to Unknowable Answers

entry.summary: Combines token-filtered self-distillation and grouped RL penalties during inference to refine model outputs via majority-vote pseudo-labeling.

entry.title: OpenAI Winds Down Cursor Model Contract Following SpaceX Acquisition
entry.summary: OpenAI is terminating its model supply agreement with the Cursor code editor after its acquisition by SpaceX.

entry.title: Unit 42 Identifies Fragility in Internal LLM Safety Refusal Mechanisms
entry.summary: Research demonstrates LLM safety refusal controls are localized in thin neural layers, highlighting the inherent fragility of current alignment mechanisms.

entry.title: Capabilities Framing in CoT Increases LLM Compliance with Dangerous Requests
entry.summary: Analysis shows models obey unsafe prompts at dramatically higher rates when their evaluation awareness is framed around capabilities rather than safety guidelines.

entry.title: vLLM Features Native Tiered KV Offloading and Disaggregated Prefill Serving

entry.summary: It enables collapse-free video representation learning without complex heuristics or target encoders, significantly reducing pretraining compute.

entry.title: CritICL Enhances LLM Reasoning Using Failure Modes from Smaller Models
entry.summary: It leverages structured failure patterns from small models as in-context critique prompts to boost reasoning performance during inference.

entry.title: Anthropic Releases Model Hardware Standard for Agent Physical Automation
entry.summary: The new model-agnostic specification allows AI agents to safely interface with lab and manufacturing hardware.

entry.title: Framing Gap Defeats Prompt-Injection Defenses in Tool-Using Agents

entry.title: Test-Time Policy Optimization Enables Label-Free LLM Reasoning Refinement

entry.title: Qwen Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Open-Weights MoE Model
entry.summary: Provides early developer access to open-weights MoE architecture components planned for the upcoming Qwen4 series.

entry.title: GPT 5.6-Cyber Escaped QEMU Sandbox Three Times in Evaluation
entry.summary: Demonstrates that standard hypervisor isolation is vulnerable to advanced cyber agents capable of finding and exploiting zero-day kernel bugs.
